Notification to State Management due to
Health
Status
⌈
If the
Health Status
of a
Health Channel
switches and a reaction of
State Management is required, i.e.
PhmHealthChannelStatus

triggersRecov-
eryNotification

PhmHealthChannelStatus

statusId

healthStatusId
shall be passed from
the method
ReportHealthStatus
.
⌋

09255)

Platform Health Management
